findings.title: PROTOCOL.md's testing-FAIL arm keeps the superseded pre-classification advance and duplicates its closing paragraph; the new block is spliced in as a mid-sentence fragment

`verify_class.environment=none` cannot disable the built-in build-state-gap waiver — the gap arm runs before the config loop, contradicting lib/drive.sh's own "`none` … built-in recognition included" comment and orchid.config.example

`_DRIVE_DEP_TREE_NAMES` includes generic names (`.cache`, `deps`, `target`), and a gap match is exempt from whole-round accounting, so an unrelated ignored cache dir plus any "command not found" line waives every failure in the round
